Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, and bacteriuria, with E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL, strongly indicating a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and prompt antimicrobial therapy.
